description: For any primitive-recursive Boolean test \(T(x,w)\), searching for its least true witness and applying the fixed output extractor gives a partial recursive function.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.normal_form_converse (T : ℕ → ℕ → Bool) (hT : Primrec₂ T) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Recursive fun v =>
    Part.map Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.extract
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.searchTest T (List.Vector.get v 0))
